<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { useFloodStore } from '../../stores/flood'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { fetchLoginCaptcha } from '../../utils/request'

/**
 * 主登录页（参考站 8443 版）：用户登录 / 机构登录 两 tab，账号密码登录。
 * - 用户登录：用户名/身份证号码/手机号码 + 登录密码 + 图形验证码
 * - 机构登录：统一社会信用代码 + 登录密码 + 图形验证码
 * 图形验证码沿用真实接口（remote 拉取 /v2.0/code；demo 显示“点击刷新”占位）。
 * 采用设计图版登录页另存为独立页面 pages/login-design/index。
 */
const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const isRemote = (import.meta.env.VITE_DATA_MODE ?? 'demo') !== 'demo'

/** 登录身份：user=用户登录；org=机构登录 */
const tab = ref<'user' | 'org'>('user')

// 用户登录：账号密码
const username = ref('')
const userPwd = ref('')
const showUserPwd = ref(false)

// 机构登录：统一社会信用代码 + 密码
const orgCode = ref('')
const orgPwd = ref('')
const showOrgPwd = ref(false)

// 验证码登录，仅用户登录 tab 提供入口（点击切换到验证码登录）
const captchaCode = ref('')
const captchaUuid = ref('')
const captchaImage = ref('')
const captchaRequired = ref(false)
const captchaLoading = ref(false)

const agreement = ref(false)
const loading = ref(false)
const error = ref('')

async function refreshCaptcha() {
  // 沿用原逻辑：仅真实后端(remote)下拉取真实图形验证码；demo 模式不请求，显示“点击刷新”占位。
  if (!isRemote) return
  captchaLoading.value = true
  try {
    const payload = await fetchLoginCaptcha()
    captchaRequired.value = payload.enabled
    captchaUuid.value = payload.uuid ?? ''
    captchaImage.value = payload.imageDataUrl ?? ''
    captchaCode.value = ''
  } catch (cause) {
    captchaRequired.value = true
    captchaUuid.value = ''
    captchaImage.value = ''
    error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '验证码加载失败'
  } finally {
    captchaLoading.value = false
  }
}

onMounted(() => { if (isRemote) void refreshCaptcha() })

function switchTab(next: 'user' | 'org') {
  if (loading.value || tab.value === next) return
  error.value = ''
  tab.value = next
}

function onCaptchaLoginLink() {
  // 进入验证码登录（设计图版登录页）
  uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login-design/index' })
}

async function submit() {
  if (loading.value) return
  error.value = ''
  if (tab.value === 'user') {
    if (!username.value.trim()) { error.value = '请输入用户名/身份证号码/手机号码'; return }
    if (!userPwd.value) { error.value = '请输入登录密码'; return }
  } else {
    if (!orgCode.value.trim()) { error.value = '请输入统一社会信用代码'; return }
    if (!orgPwd.value) { error.value = '请输入登录密码'; return }
  }
  if (captchaRequired.value) {
    if (!captchaCode.value.trim()) { error.value = '请输入图形验证码'; return }
    if (!captchaUuid.value) { error.value = '验证码已失效，请点击图片刷新'; return }
  }
  if (!agreement.value) { error.value = '请勾选同意用户协议和隐私协议'; return }

  loading.value = true
  try {
    const account = tab.value === 'user' ? username.value.trim() : orgCode.value.trim()
    const pwd = tab.value === 'user' ? userPwd.value : orgPwd.value
    const captcha = captchaRequired.value
      ? { code: captchaCode.value.trim(), uuid: captchaUuid.value }
      : undefined
    await useFloodStore().login(account, pwd, captcha)
    uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/systems/index' })
  } catch (cause) {
    error.value = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : '登录失败，请重试'
    if (isRemote) await refreshCaptcha()
  } finally {
    loading.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen login-screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <view class="login-topbar"><text class="login-topbar-title">登录</text></view>

    <view class="login-content">
      <view class="login-brand">
        <view class="login-brand-mark">
          <image class="login-brand-icon" src="/static/assets/092e1.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
        </view>
        <text class="login-brand-name">苏州市服务监管平台</text>
      </view>

      <view class="login-card">
        <!-- 用户登录 / 机构登录 分段切换 -->
        <view class="login-segmented">
          <view class="login-seg-btn" :class="{ active: tab === 'user' }" role="button" @click="switchTab('user')">用户登录</view>
          <view class="login-seg-btn" :class="{ active: tab === 'org' }" role="button" @click="switchTab('org')">机构登录</view>
        </view>

        <!-- 用户登录 -->
        <template v-if="tab === 'user'">
          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 用户名/身份证号码/手机号码</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-user.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="username" type="text" placeholder="请输入用户名/身份证号码/手机号码" :disabled="loading" @confirm="submit" />
            </view>
          </view>
          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 登录密码</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-lock.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="userPwd" :password="!showUserPwd" placeholder="请输入密码" :disabled="loading" @confirm="submit" />
              <image class="login-eye" :class="{ active: showUserPwd }" src="/static/assets/login-eye-off.svg" mode="aspectFit" role="button" @click="showUserPwd = !showUserPwd" />
            </view>
          </view>
        </template>

        <!-- 机构登录 -->
        <template v-else>
          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 统一社会信用代码</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-user.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="orgCode" type="text" placeholder="请输入统一社会信用代码" :disabled="loading" @confirm="submit" />
            </view>
          </view>
          <view class="login-field">
            <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 登录密码</text>
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-lock.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="orgPwd" :password="!showOrgPwd" placeholder="请输入密码" :disabled="loading" @confirm="submit" />
              <image class="login-eye" :class="{ active: showOrgPwd }" src="/static/assets/login-eye-off.svg" mode="aspectFit" role="button" @click="showOrgPwd = !showOrgPwd" />
            </view>
          </view>
        </template>

        <!-- 图形验证码 -->
        <view class="login-field">
          <text class="login-field-label"><text class="login-req">*</text> 图形验证码</text>
          <view class="login-captcha-row">
            <view class="login-input-shell">
              <image class="login-input-icon" src="/static/assets/login-shield.svg" mode="aspectFit" />
              <input v-model="captchaCode" type="text" maxlength="4" placeholder="请输入4位验证码" :disabled="loading || captchaLoading" @confirm="submit" />
            </view>
            <view class="login-captcha-img" role="button" aria-label="刷新验证码" @click="refreshCaptcha">
              <image v-if="captchaImage" class="login-captcha-image" :src="captchaImage" mode="aspectFit" />
              <text v-else class="login-captcha-ph">{{ captchaLoading ? '加载中' : '点击刷新' }}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>

        <view v-if="tab === 'user'" class="login-mode-link" role="button" @click="onCaptchaLoginLink">验证码登录</view>

        <text v-if="error" class="login-error">{{ error }}</text>

        <view class="login-agreement" role="checkbox" :aria-checked="agreement" @click="agreement = !agreement">
          <view class="login-checkbox" :class="{ checked: agreement }">
            <text v-if="agreement" class="login-check-glyph">✓</text>
          </view>
          <text class="login-agreement-text">请勾选同意用户协议和隐私协议</text>
        </view>

        <view class="login-submit" :class="{ disabled: loading }" role="button" @click="submit">
          <text>{{ loading ? '登录中…' : '登录' }}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>
